comment: The devlog index. One entry per post. Posts live as SvelteKit routes under src/routes/devlog/<slug>/ so they inherit the site's navbar, footer and layout rather than carrying a copy of them. Most are generated by postforge; `builtBy` says which, and hand-authored posts must say so rather than borrowing a generator's provenance.

entries.title: The Void Between the Panes
entries.dek: A responsive signup layout passed every automated check at twelve viewports and still looked wrong. What was broken was not something the checker could measure.

entries.title: The Easier Question
entries.dek: Four times in one working session a check came back green while the thing it was supposed to prove stayed false. Every one of them failed the same way.
